relevance.rationale: Garoufalidis-Hodgson-Hoffman-Rubinstein, 'The 3D-index and normal surfaces': the 3D-index of an ideal triangulation is exhibited as a generating series over (spun-)normal surfaces, connecting it to classical normal surface theory. This paper is LOAD-BEARING in the corpus already and has no ref() entry. It is cited by result number across at least six audit docs (2026-07-18-uploaded-papers-binding-mass-gap-ideas.md, 2026-07-18-borromean-3d-index.md, 2026-07-24-borromean-index-bridge-invariant.md, 2026-07-25-deltalambda-normal-surface-collective-candidate.md, 2026-08-01-ujmw-aomega-dt-index-derivation.md, 2026-08-01-arrow-a-stateintegral-saddle-not-index-series.md) and is consumed by production probes: deltalambda_normal_surface_classes_probe.py uses 'GHHR 1604.02688 Prop A.3 pairing' to compute chi on all 52 vertex spun-normal surfaces of L6a4, and figure_eight_3d_index.py checks against its m004 example and 1-efficiency criterion. Every one of those citations is a bare arXiv number in an audit doc; nothing joins them to the bibliography. Distinct from the registered garoufalidis-hodgson-rubinstein-segerman2015 (arXiv:1303.5278) -- see the mis-keying note in the proposed actions.

keyResults.statement: For a generalized angle structure alpha, the Euler characteristic of a normal surface S satisfies chi(S) = -sum_q alpha(q) x_q / pi + rho_alpha(dS) / 2pi, pairing the angle polytope against the normal-surface cone.
keyResults.useForFolio: This is the identity the Delta_lambda collective-term probe uses to compute chi and the alpha-independence check on the 52 Borromean vertex spun-normal classes; it is cited there by paper section only.

keyResults.statement: The 3D-index I^0_T(0) is a generating series summed over normal-surface classes of the ideal triangulation.
keyResults.useForFolio: The stated shape of the candidate collective binding term (idea B3) and the structure the corpus's Borromean/figure-eight index computations assume.

keyResults.statement: For a 1-efficient ideal triangulation the index sum is a genuine power series (no negative powers of q).
keyResults.useForFolio: This is self-test (i) of the corpus's Borromean 3D-index validation gate, currently cited as 'GHHR Cor 10.21' with no bibliography entry.

proposedActions.rationale: A paper cited by six audit docs and consumed by two production probes has no ref() entry; every citation is a bare arXiv id, so nothing in the bibliography pipeline sees it.
The Prop A.3 pairing and Cor 10.21 criterion are asserted in the probe and its witness with no reference key; once the entry exists the probe docstring and the audit lineage should cite it.

Flag the near-collision: 2026-08-01-arrow-a-stateintegral-saddle-not-index-series.md writes 'GHRS arXiv:1604.02688 Rmk 1.13', mixing the GHHR author string of this paper with the acronym of the already-registered garoufalidis-hodgson-rubinstein-segerman2015 (arXiv:1303.5278). Two distinct papers, and the ambiguity should be resolved when the key is minted.
